purpose: Structured intake ledger for Phase 20 manual/runtime evidence after the no-in-game gate is green.

wrongOriginRejection.expected: Non-Altmer origin cannot move crisis, Lorkhan pressure, dawn steadiness, or orthodox-cost state.

genericHookRejection.expected: Ordinary travel, friendship, spellcasting, College membership, generic anti-Thalmor violence, generic Daedric contact, and untracked vampire/werewolf state stay silent.

surveyStatusClarity.expected: Survey/MCM explains crisis state, Lorkhan pressure, scar/recovery, active favor, and curse/exile posture without route IDs.

finalPlacement.expected: One dawn/study surface and one crisis/Lorkhan pressure surface are placed outside QASmoke and still reject wrong origins.

stackSnapshot.expected: Auri-El/Magnus scholar and Exiled vampire or mortal-world pressure edge builds record active boon, favor, scar, curse, and suppressed generic layers.

manualFeelNote.expected: Player can tell pressure is authored theological friction, not punishment for ordinary Skyrim life.

wrongOriginRejection.expected: Non-Khajiit origin cannot move lunar, road-home, Baan Dar, Rajhin, or Alkosh proof state.

genericHookRejection.expected: Fast travel, generic theft, moon-sugar use, generic dragon kills, generic night stealth, caravan proximity, and repeated same-anchor travel stay silent.

surveyStatusClarity.expected: Survey/MCM explains lunar substrate, road-home cadence, focus weight, lunar posture, and active focus in race language.

finalPlacement.expected: One road-home/moon/caravan surface and one focus-specific surface are placed outside QASmoke and do not become chores.

stackSnapshot.expected: Khenarthi/Azurah road-home build and Rajhin/Baan Dar/Alkosh edge build record lunar substrate, one active focus, phase amplifier, road cadence, and shadow or curse modifier.

manualFeelNote.expected: Moon/road behavior feels like cadence and belonging, not mandatory inspection or generic thief scoring.

wrongOriginRejection.expected: Non-Argonian origin cannot move Hist, People, Void, or bed-of-choice state.

genericHookRejection.expected: Swimming loops, same-bed sleep loops, generic murder, generic stealth, one Dark Brotherhood join, generic alchemy, and random swamp travel stay silent.

surveyStatusClarity.expected: Survey/MCM labels Hist, People, Void, posture, bed-of-choice, and curse distance fictionally instead of as debug numbers.

finalPlacement.expected: One Hist/water/rest surface and one People/community or death-rite surface are placed outside QASmoke.

stackSnapshot.expected: Hist/People community build and Void/curse edge build record Hist substrate, People floor, Void threshold, bed-of-choice cadence, and Arkay/death-rite response.

manualFeelNote.expected: Hist/People support is visible before Sithis/Void depth becomes attractive.

wrongOriginRejection.expected: Non-Orc origin cannot move Stronghold, City, Legion/Exile, or self-made community state.

genericHookRejection.expected: Raw crafting, generic combat, faction joining, ore mining, vendor sales, brawls, and random stronghold proximity stay silent.

surveyStatusClarity.expected: Survey/MCM explains life mode, dignity/service posture, craft quality context, and recent mode evidence.

finalPlacement.expected: One Stronghold/quality-craft surface and one City dignity or Legion/Exile service surface are placed outside QASmoke.

stackSnapshot.expected: Stronghold forge build and City/Legion exile edge build record mode, Malacath layer, craft/context caps, community recognition, and curse modifier.

manualFeelNote.expected: City and Legion/Exile dignity can compete with Stronghold craft/combat without becoming generic smithing.

wrongOriginRejection.expected: Non-Redguard origin cannot move Crown, Forebear, Ash'abah, or Far Shores token state.

genericHookRejection.expected: Generic combat, generic undead clearing, fast travel, tomb proximity, faction membership, random sword use, and generic Arkay shrine use stay silent.

surveyStatusClarity.expected: Survey/MCM explains sect posture, death-duty state, Far Shores token, HoonDing cap, and stigma/recovery pressure.

finalPlacement.expected: One Crown/Forebear sect surface and one Ash'abah/Far Shores death-duty surface are placed outside QASmoke.

stackSnapshot.expected: Crown/Forebear expected build and Ash'abah/death-duty edge build record sect layer, death-duty token, HoonDing cap, and curse/Daedric modifier.

manualFeelNote.expected: Death-duty and martial signals do not swallow Crown form, Forebear adaptation, or Ash'abah stigma.

wrongOriginRejection.expected: Non-Bosmer origin cannot move Old Contract, Living Story, Exchange, or Bandit Road favor state.

genericHookRejection.expected: Generic kindness, generic trade, generic theft, forest travel, hunting, plant harvesting, and random bandit kills stay silent unless path-contexted.

surveyStatusClarity.expected: Survey/MCM explains active path, Pact pressure, favor counters, path switch pressure, and non-hunter route meaning.

finalPlacement.expected: One Living Story or Exchange non-hunter surface and one Bandit Road or Pact-pressure surface are placed outside QASmoke.

stackSnapshot.expected: Living Story/Exchange expected build and Old Contract/Bandit Road edge build record active path, one active favor, Pact pressure, and Baan Dar/Nocturnal/Hircine modifier.

manualFeelNote.expected: Non-hunter paths feel equally intentional instead of weaker than Old Contract proof density.

Breton.runtimeProofCommand: No Phase 20 route command yet; audit manually through Survey/status and stack review.

wrongOriginRejection.expected: Non-Breton origin cannot read Breton tradition state as native.

genericHookRejection.expected: Generic spellcasting, generic artifact use, generic aid, faction membership, and shrine attendance do not move tradition standing by themselves.

surveyStatusClarity.expected: Survey/MCM explains Knight's Road, Hidden Art, or Green Way without enabling three simultaneous reward engines.

finalPlacement.expected: P2 audit-only lane; no final placement buildout before ceiling risk is understood.

stackSnapshot.expected: Expected tradition build and edge occult/curse build record active tradition, cover/exposure, vow/druidic pressure, and suppressed parallel engines.

manualFeelNote.expected: Three traditions read as choice and pressure, not a broad stack of all Breton advantages.

genericHookRejection.expected: Generic travel, generic kills, generic sleep, generic crafting, and repeated shrine activity do not over-trigger Nord rewards.
